items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: At that time, in New Orleans, King Oliver and Louis Armstrong, those guys had already gone north.

ctx.x: Right. Well at that time it was eighth grade and then started first year. Yeah. But Howard Vorhees got me the job at the Forest Club. It was a gambling house. They didn’t call them casinos then. And we would play for dancing and so forth while people gambled. And then he finally got me to go into the Orpheum Theater. He came the contractor. He says, “Kid, I’m going to get you here.” And I started at the Orpheum Theater. Then after a while he got the job at The Frolicks night club, only a couple of blocks, where…
At that time, in New Orleans, King Oliver and Louis Armstrong, those guys had already gone north.
